newsitem.title: UK: UK's Guardian Royal to form India JVs.
newsitem.headline: UK's Guardian Royal to form India JVs.

text.p: British composite insurer Guardian Royal Exchange Plc said on Tuesday it had signed two memoranda of understanding with India's Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Co Ltd (CIFCL) to form two risk management and insurance joint ventures.

Guardian Royal said a risk management consultancy would be formed from the existing risk management operations of Guardian Insurance Services Pvt Ltd (GIS) and CIFCL, the financial services arm of the Murugappa Group.
Guardian Royal said the risk management company would service Indian national businesses and international companies within India.
The insurance company would be formed when the Indian government passes legislation permitting the private sector to operate in the general insurance industry, Guardian Royal said.
